<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" data-theme="dark">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<meta name="description" content="Ocean — a field guide to the living sea. Explore the depth zones, meet the creatures, understand the threats, and find ways to act.">
<meta name="theme-color" id="metaTheme" content="#04101c">
<title>Ocean — A Field Guide to the Living Sea</title>
<style>
/* ============================================================
   OCEAN — single-file, self-contained
   Default: deep-sea dark mode | Toggle: daylight light mode
   ============================================================ */

/* ---------- 1. Tokens ---------- */
:root{
  --font-display:"Palatino Linotype",Palatino,"Book Antiqua",Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;
  --font-body:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
  --font-mono:ui-monospace,"SF Mono","Cascadia Mono","Roboto Mono",Consolas,monospace;

  --bg:#04101c;
  --bg-2:#07182a;
  --surface:#0b1e31;
  --surface-2:#0e2438;
  --ink:#e8f3fa;
  --ink-soft:#a7c0d3;
  --ink-faint:#6b879c;
  --accent:#35d0ba;
  --accent-2:#4cc3ff;
  --line:rgba(122,190,220,.16);
  --glow:rgba(53,208,186,.28);
  --shadow:0 18px 50px -18px rgba(0,0,0,.65);
  --wave-1:rgba(38,166,154,.14);
  --wave-2:rgba(56,189,248,.10);
  --wave-3:#04101c;
  --hero-grad-1:rgba(6,26,43,.0);
  --hero-grad-2:rgba(4,16,28,.75);
  --particle-a:94,234,212;
  --particle-b:96,201,257;
  --depth-col-top:rgba(125,211,252,.9);
}
[data-theme="light"]{
  --bg:#f2f9fb;
  --bg-2:#e4f2f7;
  --surface:#ffffff;
  --surface-2:#f0f8fb;
  --ink:#0c2233;
  --ink-soft:#33526a;
  --ink-faint:#5b7689;
  --accent:#0c8f7a;
  --accent-2:#0b74b8;
  --line:rgba(11,80,120,.16);
  --glow:rgba(12,143,122,.20);
  --shadow:0 18px 44px -20px rgba(14,60,90,.25);
  --wave-1:rgba(11,116,184,.14);
  --wave-2:rgba(12,143,122,.12);
  --wave-3:#f2f9fb;
  --particle-a:12,143,122;
  --particle-b:11,116,184;
}

/* ---------- 2. Reset & base ---------- */
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:86px}
body{
  font-family:var(--font-body);
  background:var(--bg);
  color:var(--ink);
  line-height:1.65;
  font-size:clamp(15px,1.05vw,17px);
  transition:background .5s ease,color .5s ease;
  overflow-x:hidden;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
}
img,svg{display:block;max-width:100%}
a{color:inherit}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer}
::selection{background:var(--accent);color:var(--bg)}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent-2);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:4px}
.skip-link{
  position:absolute;left:1rem;top:-4rem;z-index:200;
  background:var(--accent);color:var(--bg);padding:.6rem 1rem;border-radius:8px;
  font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;transition:top .25s ease;
}
.skip-link:focus{top:1rem}

/* ---------- 3. Layout utilities ---------- */
.container{width:min(1160px,92%);margin-inline:auto}
.section{padding:clamp(4.5rem,9vw,7.5rem) 0;position:relative}
.section--alt{background:var(--bg-2);transition:background .5s ease}
.overline{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;
  font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.24em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:1.1rem;
}
.overline::before{content:"";width:28px;height:1px;background:var(--accent)}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:600;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.section-title{
  font-size:clamp(1.9rem,4vw,3rem);max-width:18ch;margin-bottom:.9rem;
}
.section-lede{max-width:56ch;color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:1.05rem}
.lead-accent{color:var(--accent)}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px);transition:opacity .8s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1),transform .8s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1);transition-delay:var(--d,0s)}
.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}

/* ---------- 4. Header / nav ---------- */
.site-header{
  position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto 0;z-index:100;
  background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 78%,transparent);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
  border-bottom:1px solid transparent;
  transition:border-color .3s ease,background .5s ease;
}
.site-header.scrolled{border-bottom-color:var(--line)}
.nav-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:68px;gap:1rem}
.brand{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;text-decoration:none;
  font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.02em;
}
.brand svg{width:30px;height:30px;color:var(--accent)}
.nav-links{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(.6rem,1.6vw,1.6rem);list-style:none}
.nav-links a{
  text-decoration:none;font-size:.86rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink-soft);
  padding:.4rem .2rem;position:relative;transition:color .25s ease;
}
.nav-links a::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:2px;border-radius:2px;
  background:var(--accent);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .3s ease;
}
.nav-links a:hover,.nav-links a.active{color:var(--ink)}
.nav-links a.active::after,.nav-links a:hover::after{transform:scaleX(1)}
.nav-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem}

/* Theme toggle */
.theme-toggle{
  width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;
  border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);
  transition:transform .4s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1),border-color .3s,box-shadow .3s,background .5s;
}
.theme-toggle:hover{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--glow);transform:rotate(28deg)}
.theme-toggle svg{width:19px;height:19px}
.theme-toggle .icon-moon,.theme-toggle .icon-sun{grid-area:1/1;transition:opacity .35s ease,transform .5s ease}
[data-theme="dark"] .theme-toggle .icon-sun{opacity:0;transform:rotate(-90deg) scale(.4)}
[data-theme="light"] .theme-toggle .icon-moon{opacity:0;transform:rotate(90deg) scale(.4)}
.theme-toggle .icon-moon{color:var(--accent-2)}
.theme-toggle .icon-sun{color:var(--accent)}

/* Progress bar */
.progress{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:-1px;height:2px;width:0%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-2));box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--glow)}

/* Mobile menu button */
.menu-btn{display:none;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);place-items:center;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:5px}
.menu-btn span{display:block;width:18px;height:2px;background:var(--ink);border-radius:2px;transition:transform .35s ease,opacity .25s ease}
.menu-btn[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(1){transform:translateY(7px) rotate(45deg)}
.menu-btn[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(2){opacity:0}
.menu-btn[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(3){transform:translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg)}

/* ---------- 5. Hero ---------- */
.hero{
  min-height:100vh;min-height:100svh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;text-align:center;
  background:
    radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% -10%,var(--bg-2) 0%,transparent 55%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,var(--bg) 0%,var(--bg) 70%,var(--bg-2) 100%);
  transition:background .5s ease;
}
.hero-canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none}
.hero-content{position:relative;z-index:3;padding:7rem 1.25rem 12rem;max-width:820px}
.hero-kicker{
  font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.75rem;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:1.4rem;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;
}
.hero-kicker::before,.hero-kicker::after{content:"";width:34px;height:1px;background:var(--accent);opacity:.6}
.hero h1{
  font-size:clamp(2.6rem,7.5vw,5.4rem);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:1.4rem;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--ink) 30%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 55%,var(--accent-2)));
  -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;
}
.hero h1 em{font-style:italic;color:var(--accent);-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--accent)}
.hero-sub{max-width:56ch;margin:0 auto 2.4rem;color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:clamp(1rem,1.5vw,1.15rem)}
.hero-cta{display:flex;gap:1rem;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.55rem;text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;
  font-size:.95rem;padding:.85rem 1.7rem;border-radius:999px;
  transition:transform .25s ease,box-shadow .3s ease,background .3s,color .3s,border-color .3s;
}
.btn-primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-2));color:#03131c;box-shadow:0 8px 30px -8px var(--glow)}
.btn-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 14px 38px -8px var(--glow)}
.btn-ghost{border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink)}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent);transform:translateY(-3px)}
[data-theme="light"] .btn-primary{color:#ffffff}

/* Waves */
.hero-waves{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:-2px;height:clamp(110px,18vw,190px);z-index:2;pointer-events:none}
.wave{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;width:200%;height:100%}
.wave path{fill:var(--wf)}
.wave-1{--wf:var(--wave-1);animation:drift 26s linear infinite}
.wave-2{--wf:var(--wave-2);animation:drift 16s linear infinite reverse;bottom:-14%}
.wave-3{--wf:var(--wave-3);animation:drift 11s linear infinite;bottom:-28%}
@keyframes drift{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-25%)}}
.scroll-cue{
  position:absolute;bottom:2rem;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:3;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;
  color:var(--ink-faint);font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.25em;text-transform:uppercase;
  text-decoration:none;
}
.scroll-cue .mouse{
  width:24px;height:38px;border:2px solid var(--ink-faint);border-radius:14px;position:relative;
}
.scroll-cue .mouse::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:7px;width:3px;height:7px;margin-left:-1.5px;
  border-radius:3px;background:var(--accent);animation:cue 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes cue{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1}60%{transform:translateY(10px);opacity:.2}}

/* ---------- 6. Stats ---------- */
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:1px;background:var(--line);border-block:1px solid var(--line)}
.stat{background:var(--bg);padding:2.2rem 1.4rem;text-align:center;transition:background .5s ease}
.section--alt .stat{background:var(--bg-2)}
.stat-num{
  font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:clamp(1.9rem,4vw,3rem);font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);
  display:block;margin-bottom:.35rem;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
}
.stat-num b{color:var(--accent);font-weight:700}
.stat-label{color:var(--ink-faint);font-size:.85rem;max-width:20ch;margin-inline:auto;display:block}

/* ---------- 7. Why it matters ---------- */
.why-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;gap:clamp(2rem,5vw,4.5rem);align-items:start}
.why-copy p{color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:1.2rem}
.why-copy p:first-of-type::first-letter{
  font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:3.4em;float:left;line-height:.82;padding-right:.12em;
  color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;
}
.fact-card{
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;
  padding:2rem;box-shadow:var(--shadow);position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  transition:background .5s ease,border-color .5s ease;
}
.fact-card::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto 0;height:4px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-2));
}
.fact-card h3{font-size:1.35rem;margin-bottom:.9rem}
.fact-card p{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.95rem}
.fact-card .fact-row{display:flex;gap:.8rem;align-items:flex-start;padding:.8rem 0;border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}
.fact-card .fact-row:first-of-type{border-top:none;padding-top:.4rem}
.fact-card .fact-ico{flex:0 0 auto;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:9px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--accent)}
.fact-card .fact-ico svg{width:17px;height:17px}
.fact-row b{display:block;font-size:.92rem}
.fact-row small{color:var(--ink-faint);font-size:.8rem}

/* ---------- 8. Depth explorer ---------- */
.depth-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:clamp(2rem,4vw,3.5rem);align-items:stretch;margin-top:2.5rem}
.zone-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.8rem}
.zone-btn{
  text-align:left;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:1rem;
  padding:1rem 1.2rem;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:var(--surface);
  transition:border-color .3s,background .3s,transform .3s,box-shadow .3s;
}
.zone-btn:hover{transform:translateX(6px);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 50%,transparent)}
.zone-btn.active{
  border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--surface-2);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--glow),var(--shadow);
}
.zone-no{
  font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.75rem;color:var(--ink-faint);
  width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line);
  display:grid;place-items:center;transition:color .3s,border-color .3s;
}
.zone-btn.active .zone-no{color:var(--bg);background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent)}
.zone-name{font-weight:600;font-size:1rem}
.zone-lat{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-faint)}
.zone-range{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.8rem;color:var(--accent)}
/* Descent column */
.descent{
  position:relative;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#8fd8ff 0%,#2f7fc4 8%,#155a94 18%,#0b3a6b 32%,#062347 48%,#03122b 66%,#010814 84%,#000309 100%);
  min-height:480px;
}
.descent .tick{
  position:absolute;left:0;right:0;border-top:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.22);
}
.descent .tick-label{
  position:absolute;right:.8rem;transform:translateY(-50%);
  font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.1em;color:rgba(235,248,255,.75);
}
.descent .tick-label.deep{color:rgba(235,248,255,.4)}
.descent .tick-label.surface{left:.8rem;right:auto;transform:none}
.marker{
  position:absolute;left:1.4rem;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:2;
  transition:top 1s cubic-bezier(.33,1,.68,1);
}
.marker .dot{
  width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:#eafcff;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(126,231,255,.35),0 0 26px 8px rgba(126,231,255,.65);
  position:relative;
}
.marker .dot::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:-8px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(190,244,255,.7);
  animation:ping 2.2s ease-out infinite;
}
@keyframes ping{0%{transform:scale(.6);opacity:.9}80%,100%{transform:scale(2.1);opacity:0}}
.readout{
  position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:3;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(2,10,20,0),rgba(2,10,20,.82) 30%);
  padding:3.4rem 1.3rem 1.2rem;color:#dceefb;
}
.readout h3{font-size:1.25rem;color:#fff}
.readout .zone-sub{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7fd8c8}
.readout .zone-desc{font-size:.82rem;color:rgba(220,238,251,.78);margin-top:.35rem;max-width:44ch}
.readout-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:.5rem;margin-top:.9rem}
.readout-cell{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:10px;padding:.55rem .7rem}
.readout-cell small{display:block;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(200,230,250,.6)}
.readout-cell strong{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.92rem;color:#eafcff;font-weight:600;transition:color .3s}

/* ---------- 9. Life / species ---------- */
.species-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(265px,1fr));gap:1.3rem;margin-top:2.5rem}
.species{
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:1.6rem;
  transition:transform .35s ease,border-color .35s ease,box-shadow .35s ease,background .5s ease;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.species::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:auto -30% -55% -30%;height:70%;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(closest-side,var(--glow),transparent);opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s ease;
}
.species:hover{transform:translateY(-7px);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 55%,transparent);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.species:hover::after{opacity:1}
.species-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:1.1rem}
.species-ico{width:52px;height:52px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:14px;background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink-soft);transition:color .35s,transform .35s}
.species:hover .species-ico{color:var(--accent);transform:rotate(-6deg) scale(1.06)}
.species-ico svg{width:34px;height:34px}
.species-ico .glowdot{fill:var(--accent);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px var(--accent))}
.species-ico .cut{fill:var(--bg)}
.species-ico .cutline{stroke:var(--bg)}
.species-range{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.7rem;color:var(--accent-2);letter-spacing:.08em}
.species h3{font-size:1.2rem;margin-bottom:.5rem}
.species p{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.9rem;position:relative;z-index:1}

/* ---------- 10. Threats ---------- */
.threats-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(255px,1fr));gap:1.3rem;margin-top:2.5rem}
.threat{
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:1.6rem;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.9rem;transition:transform .35s ease,border-color .35s,box-shadow .35s,background .5s;
}
.threat:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);border-color:rgba(255,120,90,.4);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.threat-ico{
  width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--line);color:#ff8a6b;
}
.threat-ico svg{width:23px;height:23px}
.threat h3{font-size:1.12rem}
.threat p{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.88rem;flex:1}
.meter{margin-top:auto}
.meter-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--ink-faint);margin-bottom:.4rem}
.meter-head b{color:var(--ink)}
.meter-track{height:6px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--line);overflow:hidden}
.meter-fill{
  height:100%;width:0;border-radius:99px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ff9d76,#ff5d45);
  transition:width 1.4s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1);
}
.reveal.in .meter-fill{width:var(--w)}

/* ---------- 11. Act / CTA ---------- */
.act-wrap{
  background:
    radial-gradient(90% 130% at 85% 0%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 14%,transparent),transparent 55%),
    var(--surface);
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  padding:clamp(2rem,5vw,3.6rem);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:clamp(2rem,4vw,3.5rem);
  transition:background .5s ease;
}
.act-list{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:1rem;margin-top:1.6rem}
.act-list li{display:flex;gap:.9rem;align-items:flex-start;color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.95rem}
.act-list .tick-badge{
  flex:0 0 auto;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 15%,transparent);color:var(--accent);
}
.act-list .tick-badge svg{width:13px;height:13px}
.act-list b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.act-form h3{font-size:1.4rem;margin-bottom:.6rem}
.act-form p{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.92rem;margin-bottom:1.4rem}
.field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.45rem;margin-bottom:1rem;text-align:left}
.field label{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-faint)}
.field input{
  font:inherit;padding:.85rem 1rem;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);
  background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);transition:border-color .3s,box-shadow .3s,background .5s;
}
.field input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--glow)}
.field .err{color:#ff7d63;font-size:.78rem;min-height:1em;display:none}
.field.invalid .err{display:block}
.field.invalid input{border-color:#ff7d63}
.btn-block{width:100%;justify-content:center}
.form-note{font-size:.75rem;color:var(--ink-faint);text-align:center;margin-top:.9rem}
.form-success{
  display:none;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;margin-top:1.1rem;padding:.9rem 1.1rem;border-radius:12px;
  background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 13%,transparent);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 45%,transparent);
  color:var(--ink);font-size:.9rem;
}
.form-success.show{display:flex}
.form-success svg{width:18px;height:18px;color:var(--accent);flex:0 0 auto}

/* ---------- 12. Footer ---------- */
.site-footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:2.6rem 0;background:var(--bg-2);transition:background .5s ease}
.footer-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.footer-row p{color:var(--ink-faint);font-size:.82rem}
.footer-row nav{display:flex;gap:1.4rem}
.footer-row nav a{color:var(--ink-faint);font-size:.82rem;text-decoration:none;transition:color .25s}
.footer-row nav a:hover{color:var(--accent)}
.top-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.82rem;text-decoration:none}
.top-link svg{width:14px;height:14px;transition:transform .3s}
.top-link:hover{color:var(--accent)}
.top-link:hover svg{transform:translateY(-3px)}

/* ---------- 13. Responsive ---------- */
@media (max-width:960px){
  .stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .why-grid,.depth-layout,.act-wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .descent{min-height:430px}
}
@media (max-width:820px){
  .menu-btn{display:inline-flex}
  .nav-links{
    position:fixed;top:68px;left:0;right:0;z-index:99;
    flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:0;
    background:var(--bg-2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
    padding:.6rem 4%;
    transform:translateY(-12px);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;
    transition:transform .3s ease,opacity .3s ease,visibility .3s;
  }
  .nav-links.open{transform:none;opacity:1;visibility:visible}
  .nav-links a{padding:.95rem .4rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:1rem}
  .nav-links li:last-child a{border-bottom:none}
  .nav-links a::after{display:none}
}
@media (max-width:560px){
  .stats{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .stat{padding:1.5rem .8rem}
  .readout-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .hero-cta .btn{width:100%;justify-content:center}
  .footer-row{flex-direction:column;text-align:center}
}

/* ---------- 14. Reduced motion ---------- */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
  *,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.01ms !important;animation-iteration-count:1 !important;transition-duration:.01ms !important}
  .reveal{opacity:1;transform:none}
  .marker .dot::after{animation:none;opacity:0}
}
</style>
</head>

<main id="main">

  <!-- ================= HERO ================= -->
  <section class="hero" id="top">
    <canvas class="hero-canvas" id="plankton" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
    <div class="hero-content">
      <p class="hero-kicker">A Field Guide to the Living Sea</p>
      <h1>The ocean is <em>alive</em> — and it is running out of time.</h1>
      <p class="hero-sub">It holds 97% of the planet's water, makes roughly half the air you breathe, and absorbs most of our excess heat. Eighty percent of it has never been mapped. This is the last great wilderness on Earth.</p>
      <div class="hero-cta">
        <a class="btn btn-primary" href="#depth">Begin the descent
          <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 4v16m0 0 6-6m-6 6-6-6"/></svg>
        </a>
        <a class="btn btn-ghost" href="#act">How you can act</a>
      </div>
    </div>

      <svg class="wave wave-1" viewBox="0 0 5760 140" preserveAspectRatio="none"><path d="M0 70 Q180 24 360 70 T720 70 T1080 70 T1440 70 T1800 70 T2160 70 T2520 70 T2880 70 T3240 70 T3600 70 T3960 70 T4320 70 T4680 70 T5040 70 T5400 70 T5760 70 L5760 140 L0 140 Z"/></svg>
      <svg class="wave wave-2" viewBox="0 0 5760 140" preserveAspectRatio="none"><path d="M0 74 Q180 30 360 74 T720 74 T1080 74 T1440 74 T1800 74 T2160 74 T2520 74 T2880 74 T3240 74 T3600 74 T3960 74 T4320 74 T4680 74 T5040 74 T5400 74 T5760 74 L5760 140 L0 140 Z"/></svg>
      <svg class="wave wave-3" viewBox="0 0 5760 140" preserveAspectRatio="none"><path d="M0 78 Q180 40 360 78 T720 78 T1080 78 T1440 78 T1800 78 T2160 78 T2520 78 T2880 78 T3240 78 T3600 78 T3960 78 T4320 78 T4680 78 T5040 78 T5400 78 T5760 78 L5760 140 L0 140 Z"/></svg>
    </div>

    <a class="scroll-cue" href="#vital"><span class="mouse" aria-hidden="true"></span>Scroll</a>
  </section>

  <!-- ================= VITAL SIGNS ================= -->
  <section class="section" id="vital" data-spy-section>
    <div class="container">
      <div class="stats reveal">
        <div class="stat">
          <span class="stat-num"><b data-count="71" data-suffix="%">0</b></span>
          <span class="stat-label">of Earth's surface is ocean — a planet, seen from space, is a blue one</span>
        </div>
        <div class="stat">
          <span class="stat-num"><b data-count="97" data-suffix="%">0</b></span>
          <span class="stat-label">of all water on Earth is in the sea; the rest is oceans in all but name</span>
        </div>
        <div class="stat">
          <span class="stat-num"><b data-count="80" data-suffix="%">0</b></span>
          <span class="stat-label">of the deep ocean remains unmapped, unobserved, and unvisited</span>
        </div>
        <div class="stat">
          <span class="stat-num"><b data-count="100000" data-suffix="+">0</b></span>
          <span class="stat-label">marine species have been described — scientists estimate the real count is many times higher</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="section section--alt" aria-labelledby="whyTitle">
    <div class="container why-grid">
      <div class="why-copy reveal">
        <p class="overline">Vital Signs</p>
        <h2 class="section-title" id="whyTitle">Half of every breath you take is the ocean's.</h2>
        <p>Long before the first forest, tiny drifting plants called phytoplankton began photosynthesising at sea. Together with other marine life, they still produce roughly half of the oxygen in the atmosphere — more than all of the Amazon rainforest combined.</p>
        <p>The ocean is also Earth's great thermostat. It has absorbed more than 90% of the extra heat trapped by greenhouse gases, along with about a quarter of the carbon dioxide we have emitted. That buffering is why the planet has not warmed faster — and it is why the sea is warming, acidifying, and losing oxygen at the same time.</p>
        <p>Every coastline, weather system, drinking-water supply, and food supply on land is downstream of what happens in the water. Caring for the ocean is not a niche environmental issue. It is the baseline condition of life on Earth.</p>
      </div>

      <aside class="fact-card reveal" style="--d:.15s" aria-label="Key facts">
        <h3>Numbers worth holding</h3>
        <p>Small figures, enormous consequences.</p>
        <div class="fact-row">
          <span class="fact-ico" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 3s6 6.4 6 10.2A6 6 0 0 1 6 13.2C6 9.4 12 3 12 3Z"/></svg></span>
          <div><b>Every 2 minutes</b><small>a cargo ship's worth of plastic enters the sea</small></div>
        </div>
        <div class="fact-row">
          <span class="fact-ico" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M4 15c2-2.5 4-2.5 6 0s4 2.5 6 0 4-2.5 6 0M4 9c2-2.5 4-2.5 6 0s4 2.5 6 0 4-2.5 6 0"/></svg></span>
          <div><b>3 billion tonnes</b><small>of CO₂ the ocean absorbs every year</small></div>
        </div>
        <div class="fact-row">
          <span class="fact-ico" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M3 12h18M12 3c3 3.5 3 14.5 0 18M12 3c-3 3.5-3 14.5 0 18"/></svg></span>
          <div><b>≈ 3.5 billion people</b><small>depend on the ocean for a primary source of protein</small></div>
        </div>
        <div class="fact-row">
          <span class="fact-ico" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 21s-7-4.6-7-10a7 7 0 0 1 14 0c0 5.4-7 10-7 10Z"/><circle cx="12" cy="11" r="2.5"/></svg></span>
          <div><b>11,000 metres</b><small>down to Challenger Deep — deeper than Everest is tall</small></div>
        </div>
      </aside>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ================= DEPTH ================= -->
  <section class="section" id="depth" aria-labelledby="depthTitle">
    <div class="container">
      <p class="overline reveal">The Descent</p>
      <h2 class="section-title reveal" id="depthTitle">Five worlds, stacked from sunlight to midnight.</h2>
      <p class="section-lede reveal">As you sink, light fails first, then warmth, then almost everything we recognise as "surface life." Select a zone to take a submersible there — the pressure gauge is not exaggerating.</p>

      <div class="depth-layout">
        <div class="zone-list reveal" role="tablist" aria-label="Ocean depth zones">
          <button class="zone-btn active" data-zone="0" role="tab" aria-selected="true">
            <span class="zone-no">I</span>
            <span><span class="zone-name">Sunlight Zone</span><br><span class="zone-lat">Epipelagic · warm, bright, crowded</span></span>
            <span class="zone-range">0–200 m</span>
          </button>
          <button class="zone-btn" data-zone="1" role="tab" aria-selected="false">
            <span class="zone-no">II</span>
            <span><span class="zone-name">Twilight Zone</span><br><span class="zone-lat">Mesopelagic · the last blue glow</span></span>
            <span class="zone-range">200–1,000 m</span>
          </button>
          <button class="zone-btn" data-zone="2" role="tab" aria-selected="false">
            <span class="zone-no">III</span>
            <span><span class="zone-name">Midnight Zone</span><br><span class="zone-lat">Bathypelagic · bioluminescent darkness</span></span>
            <span class="zone-range">1,000–4,000 m</span>
          </button>
          <button class="zone-btn" data-zone="3" role="tab" aria-selected="false">
            <span class="zone-no">IV</span>
            <span><span class="zone-name">The Abyss</span><br><span class="zone-lat">Abyssopelagic · the largest habitat on Earth</span></span>
            <span class="zone-range">4,000–6,000 m</span>
          </button>
          <button class="zone-btn" data-zone="4" role="tab" aria-selected="false">
            <span class="zone-no">V</span>
            <span><span class="zone-name">The Trenches</span><br><span class="zone-lat">Hadalpelagic · life under a mountain of water</span></span>
            <span class="zone-range">6,000–11,000 m</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        <div class="descent reveal" style="--d:.15s" aria-live="polite">
          <div class="tick" style="top:0%"><span class="tick-label surface" style="top:.7rem">0 m · surface</span></div>
          <div class="tick" style="top:1.8%"><span class="tick-label deep" style="top:1.8%">200 m</span></div>
          <div class="tick" style="top:9.1%"><span class="tick-label deep" style="top:9.1%">1,000 m</span></div>
          <div class="tick" style="top:36.4%"><span class="tick-label deep" style="top:36.4%">4,000 m</span></div>
          <div class="tick" style="top:54.5%"><span class="tick-label deep" style="top:54.5%">6,000 m</span></div>
          <div class="tick" style="top:99.5%"><span class="tick-label deep" style="top:98%">11,000 m · Challenger Deep</span></div>

          <div class="marker" id="depthMarker" style="top:1%">
            <span class="dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          </div>

          <div class="readout">
            <span class="zone-sub" id="roLat">Epipelagic</span>
            <h3 id="roName">Sunlight Zone</h3>
            <p class="zone-desc" id="roDesc">Sunlit, warm and crowded: nearly all coral reefs and the bulk of marine life live here, built on phytoplankton that turn light into the base of the food web.</p>
            <div class="readout-grid">
              <div class="readout-cell"><small>Depth</small><strong id="roDepth">0–200 m</strong></div>
              <div class="readout-cell"><small>Temp</small><strong id="roTemp">~20 °C</strong></div>
              <div class="readout-cell"><small>Sunlight</small><strong id="roLight">100 → 1%</strong></div>
              <div class="readout-cell"><small>Pressure</small><strong id="roPres">~21 atm</strong></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ================= LIFE ================= -->
  <section class="section section--alt" id="life" aria-labelledby="lifeTitle">
    <div class="container">
      <p class="overline reveal">Life</p>
      <h2 class="section-title reveal" id="lifeTitle">Residents of the water column.</h2>
      <p class="section-lede reveal">From the largest animal that has ever existed to a fish filmed at a depth where the pressure could crush a submarine hull — the sea keeps inventing life we barely know.</p>

      <div class="species-grid">
        <article class="species reveal">
          <div class="species-top">
            <span class="species-ico" aria-hidden="true">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" fill="currentColor">
                <path d="M6 36c4-13 22-20 37-15 8 2.6 13 8 13 12-2.5 2.6-6.5 3.6-10.5 3.2 1.8 3.6.9 7.6-2.4 10.6-1.8-2.7-5-3.7-8-3l-.6-3.2C25 45 12 43.5 6 36Z"/>
                <circle class="cut" cx="45" cy="30.5" r="2"/>
                <path d="M18 20c-1.5-4-1.5-7 .5-10M24 22c-1-3.4-.6-6.6 1.4-9.4" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
              </svg>
            </span>
            <span class="species-range">0 – 100 m</span>
          </div>
          <h3>Blue Whale</h3>
          <p>The largest animal to have ever lived — up to 30 metres long, with a heart the size of a small car and a voice you can hear from kilometres away.</p>
        </article>

        <article class="species reveal" style="--d:.08s">
          <div class="species-top">
            <span class="species-ico" aria-hidden="true">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" fill="currentColor">
                <path d="M32 12c3.4 0 6.6.5 9.4 1.6C47 17 53 24 57 34c-7.6-4.2-15.6-6.4-25-6.4S14.6 30 7 34c4-10 10-17 15.6-20.4C25.4 12.5 28.6 12 32 12Z"/>
                <path class="cutline" d="M30 20c2 4 2 8 0 12M34 20c-2 4-2 8 0 12" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none" opacity=".5"/>
                <path d="M32 34v18c0 2-1.4 3-3 4 1-3 .4-5.6-1-8" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
              </svg>
            </span>
            <span class="species-range">0 – 50 m</span>
          </div>
          <h3>Manta Ray</h3>
          <p>The largest brain of any fish — about four times the relative size of a human's. Mantas are known to visit cleaning stations by name, almost like a place.</p>
        </article>

        <article class="species reveal" style="--d:.16s">
          <div class="species-top">
            <span class="species-ico" aria-hidden="true">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" fill="currentColor">
                <path d="M14 32c6-8 16-12 26-9l12 9-12 9c-10 3-20-1-26-9Z"/>
                <path d="M34 22c3-4 8-6 13-5-2 4-5 6-9 7ZM36 42c3 4 8 6 13 5-2-4-5-6-9-7Z" opacity=".8"/>
                <circle class="cut" cx="21" cy="30" r="1.8"/>
                <circle class="glowdot" cx="26" cy="38" r="2.4"/>
              </svg>
            </span>
            <span class="species-range">30 – 700 m</span>
          </div>
          <h3>Lanternfish</h3>
          <p>Possibly the most abundant vertebrate on Earth. Every night, billions rise through the twilight zone in the largest migration of animals anywhere on the planet.</p>
        </article>

        <article class="species reveal" style="--d:.24s">
          <div class="species-top">
            <span class="species-ico" aria-hidden="true">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" fill="currentColor">
                <path d="M32 12c10 0 17 7 17 15 0 4-2 7-5 9H20c-3-2-5-5-5-9 0-8 7-15 17-15Z"/>
                <path d="M21 38c-1 6 1 12 4 16M28 38c0 7-1 13-3 18M36 38c0 7 1 13 3 18M43 38c1 6-1 12-4 16" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
                <circle class="cut" cx="26" cy="26" r="2"/><circle class="cut" cx="38" cy="26" r="2"/>
              </svg>
            </span>
            <span class="species-range">600 – 900 m</span>
          </div>
          <h3>Vampire Squid</h3>
          <p>Neither vampire nor squid — a living fossil that glows with hundreds of photophores when threatened and can switch off its metabolism to survive oxygen-poor water.</p>
        </article>

        <article class="species reveal" style="--d:.32s">
          <div class="species-top">
            <span class="species-ico" aria-hidden="true">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" fill="currentColor">
                <path d="M10 36c3-9 14-14 25-11 4 1 7 3 9 6l8-3c-2 3-3 6-3 9s1 6 3 9l-8-3c-2 3-5 5-9 6-11 3-22-2-25-13Z"/>
                <path d="M30 25c-1-5 1-9 5-12" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
                <circle class="glowdot" cx="37" cy="11.5" r="3.4"/>
                <circle class="cut" cx="18" cy="34" r="2"/>
                <path class="cutline" d="M15 38l3 2 2-2 3 3" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
              </svg>
            </span>
            <span class="species-range">900 – 4,500 m</span>
          </div>
          <h3>Anglerfish</h3>
          <p>In the lightless midnight zone, she grows a glowing lure from her own spine and dangles it in the dark — the sea's oldest trick, perfected over 300 million years.</p>
        </article>

        <article class="species reveal" style="--d:.4s">
          <div class="species-top">
            <span class="species-ico" aria-hidden="true">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round">
                <path d="M10 22c8 8 14 2 20 8s10 10 16 10c4 0 7-2 8-5" />
                <path d="M12 26c5 5 9 3 13 7" opacity=".55"/>
              </svg>
            </span>
            <span class="species-range">8,336 m</span>
          </div>
          <h3>Hadal Snailfish</h3>
          <p>Filmed in 2023 in the Izu-Ogasawara Trench — the deepest fish ever seen. A soft-bodied, gelatinous creature thriving where pressure would crush a steel hull.</p>
        </article>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ================= THREATS ================= -->
  <section class="section" id="threats" aria-labelledby="threatsTitle">
    <div class="container">
      <p class="overline reveal">Threats</p>
      <h2 class="section-title reveal" id="threatsTitle">Four pressures, one fragile system.</h2>
      <p class="section-lede reveal">The ocean's problems are not separate. Warming drives acidification; acidification weakens the shell-builders; both expand oxygen deserts. The bars below show how far each pressure has already moved.</p>

      <div class="threats-grid">
        <article class="threat reveal">
          <span class="threat-ico" aria-hidden="true">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M10 4a2 2 0 1 1 4 0v9.3a4.5 4.5 0 1 1-4 0Z"/><circle cx="12" cy="17" r="1.8" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/><path d="M12 13.5V9"/></svg>
          </span>
          <h3>Warming</h3>
          <p>The ocean has absorbed over 90% of the excess heat trapped by greenhouse gases. Corals that build at narrow temperature windows are now bleaching at global scale.</p>
          <div class="meter">

<script>
(function(){
"use strict";

/* ---------- Helpers ---------- */
var $  = function(s, c){ return (c || document).querySelector(s); };
var $$ = function(s, c){ return Array.prototype.slice.call((c || document).querySelectorAll(s)); };
var reduceMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

/* ---------- Theme (default: dark) ---------- */
var root = document.documentElement;
var toggle = $("#themeToggle");
var metaTheme = $("#metaTheme");
var THEME_KEY = "ocean-theme";

function applyTheme(theme){
  root.setAttribute("data-theme", theme);
  var light = theme === "light";
  toggle.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(light));
  toggle.setAttribute("aria-label", light ? "Switch to dark theme" : "Switch to light theme");
  metaTheme.setAttribute("content", light ? "#f2f9fb" : "#04101c");
}
(function initTheme(){
  var saved = null;
  try { saved = localStorage.getItem(THEME_KEY); } catch(e){}
  applyTheme(saved === "light" ? "light" : "dark");
})();
toggle.addEventListener("click", function(){
  var next = root.getAttribute("data-theme") === "light" ? "dark" : "light";
  applyTheme(next);
  try { localStorage.setItem(THEME_KEY, next); } catch(e){}
  if (window.__planktonRecolor) window.__planktonRecolor();
});

/* ---------- Mobile menu ---------- */
var menuBtn = $("#menuBtn");
var navLinks = $("#navLinks");
menuBtn.addEventListener("click", function(){
  var open = navLinks.classList.toggle("open");
  menuBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
});
$$("#navLinks a").forEach(function(a){
  a.addEventListener("click", function(){
    navLinks.classList.remove("open");
    menuBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
  });
});

/* ---------- Header state + reading progress ---------- */
var header = $("#siteHeader");
var bar = $("#progressBar");
var ticking = false;
function onScroll(){
  var y = window.scrollY || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
  header.classList.toggle("scrolled", y > 10);
  var max = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight;
  bar.style.width = (max > 0 ? Math.min(100, y / max * 100) : 0) + "%";
  ticking = false;
}
window.addEventListener("scroll", function(){
  if(!ticking){ requestAnimationFrame(onScroll); ticking = true; }
}, { passive:true });
onScroll();

/* ---------- Scrollspy ---------- */
var spyLinks = $$("#navLinks a[data-spy]");
var spyMap = {};
spyLinks.forEach(function(a){ spyMap[a.getAttribute("href").slice(1)] = a; });
var spySections = $$("[id]").filter(function(el){ return !!spyMap[el.id]; });
if ("IntersectionObserver" in window && spySections.length){
  var spyIO = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(en){
      if (en.isIntersecting){
        spyLinks.forEach(function(a){ a.classList.remove("active"); });
        var link = spyMap[en.target.id];
        if (link) link.classList.add("active");
      }
    });
  }, { rootMargin: "-40% 0px -55% 0px" });
  spySections.forEach(function(s){ spyIO.observe(s); });
}

/* ---------- Reveal on scroll ---------- */
var revealEls = $$(".reveal");
if ("IntersectionObserver" in window && !reduceMotion){
  var revealIO = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(en){
      if (en.isIntersecting){ en.target.classList.add("in"); revealIO.unobserve(en.target); }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: "0px 0px -6% 0px" });
  revealEls.forEach(function(el){ revealIO.observe(el); });
} else {
  revealEls.forEach(function(el){ el.classList.add("in"); });
}

/* ---------- Count-up stats ---------- */
function animateCount(el){
  var target = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-count")) || 0;
  var suffix = el.getAttribute("data-suffix") || "";
  var dur = 1600, t0 = null;
  function fmt(n){ return Math.round(n).toLocaleString("en-US"); }
  if (reduceMotion){ el.textContent = fmt(target) + suffix; return; }
  function step(ts){
    if (!t0) t0 = ts;
    var p = Math.min(1, (ts - t0) / dur);
    var eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3);
    el.textContent = fmt(target * eased) + suffix;
    if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(step);
}
var counters = $$("[data-count]");
if ("IntersectionObserver" in window){
  var countIO = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(en){

  }, { threshold: 0.4 });

  counters.forEach(animateCount);

/* ---------- Plankton canvas (hero) ---------- */
(function plankton(){
  var canvas = $("#plankton");
  if (!canvas || !canvas.getContext) return;
  var ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  var W = 0, H = 0, dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);

    var a = light ? "12,143,122" : "94,234,212";
    var b = light ? "11,116,184" : "96,201,257";
    var base = light ? 0.35 : 0.8;
    return [a, b, base];
  }
  function make(n){
    var c = colors();
    parts = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++){
      parts.push({
        x: Math.random() * W,
        y: Math.random() * H,
        r: 0.6 + Math.random() * 1.9,
        vy: 0.08 + Math.random() * 0.3,
        ph: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        sw: 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.5,
        a: 0.15 + Math.random() * 0.5,
        tw: 0.5 + Math.random() * 2,
        c: Math.random() < 0.5 ? c[0] : c[1],
        base: c[2]
      });

  }
  function resize(){
    var rect = canvas.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();

    canvas.width = W * dpr; canvas.height = H * dpr;

  }

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    parts.forEach(function(p){
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(" + p.c + "," + (p.a * p.base) + ")";
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    });
  }
  function frame(t){
    if (!running) return;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++){
      var p = parts[i];
      p.y -= p.vy;

      if (p.y < -6){ p.y = H + 6; p.x = Math.random() * W; }
      if (p.x < -6) p.x = W + 6;
      if (p.x > W + 6) p.x = -6;
      var tw = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(t / 700 * p.tw + p.ph);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(" + p.c + "," + (p.a * p.base * tw) + ")";

    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", function(){
      if (document.hidden){ running = false; cancelAnimationFrame(raf); }
      else if (!running){ running = true; raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame); }
    });

    raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);

/* Mobile menu button */
.menu-btn{display:none;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);place-items:center;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:5px}
.menu-btn span{display:block;width:18px;height:2px;background:var(--ink);border-radius:2px;transition:transform .35s ease,opacity .25s ease}
.menu-btn[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(1){transform:translateY(7px) rotate(45deg)}
.menu-btn[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(2){opacity:0}
.menu-btn[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(3){transform:translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg)}

/* ---------- 5. Hero ---------- */
.hero{
  min-height:100svh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;text-align:center;
  background:
    radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% -10%,var(--bg-2) 0%,transparent 55%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,var(--bg) 0%,var(--bg) 70%,var(--bg-2) 100%);
  transition:background .5s ease;
}
.hero-canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none}
.hero-content{position:relative;z-index:3;padding:7rem 1.25rem 12rem;max-width:820px}
.hero-kicker{
  font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.75rem;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:1.4rem;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;
}
.hero-kicker::before,.hero-kicker::after{content:"";width:34px;height:1px;background:var(--accent);opacity:.6}
.hero h1{
  font-size:clamp(2.6rem,7.5vw,5.4rem);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:1.4rem;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--ink) 30%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 55%,var(--accent-2)));
  -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;
}
.hero h1 em{font-style:italic;color:var(--accent);-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--accent)}
.hero-sub{max-width:56ch;margin:0 auto 2.4rem;color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:clamp(1rem,1.5vw,1.15rem)}
.hero-cta{display:flex;gap:1rem;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.55rem;text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;
  font-size:.95rem;padding:.85rem 1.7rem;border-radius:999px;
  transition:transform .25s ease,box-shadow .3s ease,background .3s,color .3s,border-color .3s;
}
.btn-primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-2));color:#03131c;box-shadow:0 8px 30px -8px var(--glow)}
.btn-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 14px 38px -8px var(--glow)}
.btn-ghost{border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink)}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent);transform:translateY(-3px)}
[data-theme="light"] .btn-primary{color:#ffffff}

/* Waves */
.hero-waves{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:-2px;height:clamp(110px,18vw,190px);z-index:2;pointer-events:none}
.wave{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%}
.wave path{fill:var(--wf)}
.wave-1{--wf:var(--wave-1);animation:drift 26s linear infinite}
.wave-2{--wf:var(--wave-2);animation:drift 16s linear infinite reverse;bottom:-14%}
.wave-3{--wf:var(--wave-3);animation:drift 11s linear infinite;bottom:-28%}
@keyframes drift{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-25%)}}
.scroll-cue{
  position:absolute;bottom:2rem;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:3;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;
  color:var(--ink-faint);font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.25em;text-transform:uppercase;
  text-decoration:none;
}
.scroll-cue .mouse{
  width:24px;height:38px;border:2px solid var(--ink-faint);border-radius:14px;position:relative;
}
.scroll-cue .mouse::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:7px;width:3px;height:7px;margin-left:-1.5px;
  border-radius:3px;background:var(--accent);animation:cue 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes cue{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1}60%{transform:translateY(10px);opacity:.2}}

/* ---------- 6. Stats ---------- */
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:1px;background:var(--line);border-block:1px solid var(--line)}
.stat{background:var(--bg);padding:2.2rem 1.4rem;text-align:center;transition:background .5s ease}
.section--alt .stat{background:var(--bg-2)}
.stat-num{
  font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:clamp(1.9rem,4vw,3rem);font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);
  display:block;margin-bottom:.35rem;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
}
.stat-num b{color:var(--accent);font-weight:700}
.stat-label{color:var(--ink-faint);font-size:.85rem;max-width:20ch;margin-inline:auto;display:block}

/* ---------- 7. Why it matters ---------- */
.why-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;gap:clamp(2rem,5vw,4.5rem);align-items:start}
.why-copy p{color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:1.2rem}
.why-copy p:first-of-type::first-letter{
  font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:3.4em;float:left;line-height:.82;padding-right:.12em;
  color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;
}
.fact-card{
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;
  padding:2rem;box-shadow:var(--shadow);position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  transition:background .5s ease,border-color .5s ease;
}
.fact-card::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto 0;height:4px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-2));
}
.fact-card h3{font-size:1.35rem;margin-bottom:.9rem}
.fact-card p{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.95rem}
.fact-card .fact-row{display:flex;gap:.8rem;align-items:flex-start;padding:.8rem 0;border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}
.fact-card .fact-row:first-of-type{border-top:none;padding-top:.4rem}
.fact-card .fact-ico{flex:0 0 auto;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:9px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--accent)}
.fact-card .fact-ico svg{width:17px;height:17px}
.fact-row b{display:block;font-size:.92rem}
.fact-row small{color:var(--ink-faint);font-size:.8rem}

/* ---------- 8. Depth explorer ---------- */
.depth-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:clamp(2rem,4vw,3.5rem);align-items:stretch;margin-top:2.5rem}
.zone-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.8rem}
.zone-btn{
  text-align:left;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:1rem;
  padding:1rem 1.2rem;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:var(--surface);
  transition:border-color .3s,background .3s,transform .3s,box-shadow .3s;
}
.zone-btn:hover{transform:translateX(6px);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 50%,transparent)}
.zone-btn.active{
  border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--surface-2);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--glow),var(--shadow);
}
.zone-no{
  font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.75rem;color:var(--ink-faint);
  width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line);
  display:grid;place-items:center;transition:color .3s,border-color .3s;
}
.zone-btn.active .zone-no{color:var(--bg);background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent)}
.zone-name{font-weight:600;font-size:1rem}
.zone-lat{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-faint)}
.zone-range{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.8rem;color:var(--accent)}
/* Descent column */
.descent{
  position:relative;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#8fd8ff 0%,#2f7fc4 8%,#155a94 18%,#0b3a6b 32%,#062347 48%,#03122b 66%,#010814 84%,#000309 100%);
  min-height:480px;
}
.descent .tick{
  position:absolute;left:0;right:0;border-top:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.22);
}
.descent .tick-label{
  position:absolute;right:.8rem;transform:translateY(-50%);
  font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.1em;color:rgba(235,248,255,.75);
}
.descent .tick-label.deep{color:rgba(235,248,255,.4)}
.marker{
  position:absolute;left:1.4rem;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:2;
  transition:top 1s cubic-bezier(.33,1,.68,1);
}
.marker .dot{
  width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:#eafcff;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(126,231,255,.35),0 0 26px 8px rgba(126,231,255,.65);
  position:relative;
}
.marker .dot::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:-8px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(190,244,255,.7);
  animation:ping 2.2s ease-out infinite;
}
@keyframes ping{0%{transform:scale(.6);opacity:.9}80%,100%{transform:scale(2.1);opacity:0}}
.readout{
  position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:3;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(2,10,20,0),rgba(2,10,20,.82) 30%);
  padding:3.4rem 1.3rem 1.2rem;color:#dceefb;
}
.readout h3{font-size:1.25rem;color:#fff}
.readout .zone-sub{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7fd8c8}
.readout .zone-desc{font-size:.82rem;color:rgba(220,238,251,.78);margin-top:.35rem;max-width:44ch}
.readout-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:.5rem;margin-top:.9rem}
.readout-cell{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:10px;padding:.55rem .7rem}
.readout-cell small{display:block;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(200,230,250,.6)}
.readout-cell strong{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.92rem;color:#eafcff;font-weight:600;transition:color .3s}

/* ---------- 9. Life / species ---------- */
.species-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(265px,1fr));gap:1.3rem;margin-top:2.5rem}
.species{
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:1.6rem;
  transition:transform .35s ease,border-color .35s ease,box-shadow .35s ease,background .5s ease;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.species::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:auto -30% -55% -30%;height:70%;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(closest-side,var(--glow),transparent);opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s ease;
}
.species:hover{transform:translateY(-7px);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 55%,transparent);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.species:hover::after{opacity:1}
.species-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:1.1rem}
.species-ico{width:52px;height:52px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:14px;background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink-soft);transition:color .35s,transform .35s}
.species:hover .species-ico{color:var(--accent);transform:rotate(-6deg) scale(1.06)}
.species-ico svg{width:34px;height:34px}
.species-ico .glowdot{fill:var(--accent);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px var(--accent))}
.species-range{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.7rem;color:var(--accent-2);letter-spacing:.08em}
.species h3{font-size:1.2rem;margin-bottom:.5rem}
.species p{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.9rem;position:relative;z-index:1}

/* ---------- 10. Threats ---------- */
.threats-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(255px,1fr));gap:1.3rem;margin-top:2.5rem}
.threat{
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:1.6rem;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.9rem;transition:transform .35s ease,border-color .35s,box-shadow .35s,background .5s;
}
.threat:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);border-color:rgba(255,120,90,.4);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.threat-ico{
  width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--line);color:#ff8a6b;
}
.threat-ico svg{width:23px;height:23px}
.threat h3{font-size:1.12rem}
.threat p{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.88rem;flex:1}
.meter{margin-top:auto}
.meter-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--ink-faint);margin-bottom:.4rem}
.meter-head b{color:var(--ink)}
.meter-track{height:6px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--line);overflow:hidden}
.meter-fill{
  height:100%;width:0;border-radius:99px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ff9d76,#ff5d45);
  transition:width 1.4s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1);
}
.reveal.in .meter-fill{width:var(--w)}

/* ---------- 11. Act / CTA ---------- */
.act-wrap{
  background:
    radial-gradient(90% 130% at 85% 0%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 14%,transparent),transparent 55%),
    var(--surface);
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  padding:clamp(2rem,5vw,3.6rem);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:clamp(2rem,4vw,3.5rem);
  transition:background .5s ease;
}
.act-list{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:1rem;margin-top:1.6rem}
.act-list li{display:flex;gap:.9rem;align-items:flex-start;color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.95rem}
.act-list .tick-badge{
  flex:0 0 auto;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 15%,transparent);color:var(--accent);
}
.act-list .tick-badge svg{width:13px;height:13px}
.act-list b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.act-form h3{font-size:1.4rem;margin-bottom:.6rem}
.act-form p{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.92rem;margin-bottom:1.4rem}
.field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.45rem;margin-bottom:1rem;text-align:left}
.field label{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-faint)}
.field input{
  font:inherit;padding:.85rem 1rem;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);
  background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);transition:border-color .3s,box-shadow .3s,background .5s;
}
.field input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--glow)}
.field .err{color:#ff7d63;font-size:.78rem;min-height:1em;display:none}
.field.invalid .err{display:block}
.field.invalid input{border-color:#ff7d63}
.btn-block{width:100%;justify-content:center}
.form-note{font-size:.75rem;color:var(--ink-faint);text-align:center;margin-top:.9rem}
.form-success{
  display:none;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;margin-top:1.1rem;padding:.9rem 1.1rem;border-radius:12px;
  background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 13%,transparent);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 45%,transparent);
  color:var(--ink);font-size:.9rem;
}
.form-success.show{display:flex}
.form-success svg{width:18px;height:18px;color:var(--accent);flex:0 0 auto}

/* ---------- 12. Footer ---------- */
.site-footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:2.6rem 0;background:var(--bg-2);transition:background .5s ease}
.footer-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.footer-row p{color:var(--ink-faint);font-size:.82rem}
.footer-row nav{display:flex;gap:1.4rem}
.footer-row nav a{color:var(--ink-faint);font-size:.82rem;text-decoration:none;transition:color .25s}
.footer-row nav a:hover{color:var(--accent)}
.top-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.82rem;text-decoration:none}
.top-link svg{width:14px;height:14px;transition:transform .3s}
.top-link:hover{color:var(--accent)}
.top-link:hover svg{transform:translateY(-3px)}

/* ---------- 13. Responsive ---------- */
@media (max-width:960px){
  .stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .why-grid,.depth-layout,.act-wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .descent{min-height:430px}
}
@media (max-width:820px){
  .menu-btn{display:inline-flex}
  .nav-links{
    position:fixed;top:68px;left:0;right:0;z-index:99;
    flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:0;
    background:var(--bg-2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
    padding:.6rem 4%;
    transform:translateY(-12px);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;
    transition:transform .3s ease,opacity .3s ease,visibility .3s;
  }
  .nav-links.open{transform:none;opacity:1;visibility:visible}
  .nav-links a{padding:.95rem .4rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:1rem}
  .nav-links li:last-child a{border-bottom:none}
  .nav-links a::after{display:none}
}
@media (max-width:560px){
  .stats{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .stat{padding:1.5rem .8rem}
  .readout-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .hero-cta .btn{width:100%;justify-content:center}
  .footer-row{flex-direction:column;text-align:center}
}

/* ---------- 14. Reduced motion ---------- */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
  *,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.01ms !important;animation-iteration-count:1 !important;transition-duration:.01ms !important}
  .reveal{opacity:1;transform:none}
  .marker .dot::after{animation:none;opacity:0}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- ================= HEADER ================= -->
<header class="site-header" id="siteHeader">
  <div class="container nav-bar">
    <a class="brand" href="#top" aria-label="Ocean — back to top">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 32 32" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true">
        <path d="M3 11c4-5 8-5 12 0s8 5 12 0"/>
        <path d="M3 18c4-5 8-5 12 0s8 5 12 0"/>
        <path d="M3 25c4-5 8-5 12 0s8 5 12 0"/>
      </svg>
      Ocean
    </a>

    <nav aria-label="Primary">
      <ul class="nav-links" id="navLinks">
        <li><a href="#vital" data-spy>Vital Signs</a></li>
        <li><a href="#depth" data-spy>The Descent</a></li>
        <li><a href="#life" data-spy>Life</a></li>
        <li><a href="#threats" data-spy>Threats</a></li>
        <li><a href="#act" data-spy>Act</a></li>
      </ul>
    </nav>

    <div class="nav-actions">
      <button class="theme-toggle" id="themeToggle" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Switch to light theme" title="Switch theme">
        <span style="display:grid;place-items:center">
          <svg class="icon-moon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M21 12.8A9 9 0 1 1 11.2 3a7 7 0 0 0 9.8 9.8Z"/></svg>
          <svg class="icon-sun" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true">
            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4.2"/>
            <path d="M12 2.5v2.4M12 19.1v2.4M2.5 12h2.4M19.1 12h2.4M4.9 4.9l1.7 1.7M17.4 17.4l1.7 1.7M4.9 19.1l1.7-1.7M17.4 6.6l1.7-1.7"/>
          </svg>
        </span>
      </button>
      <button class="menu-btn" id="menuBtn" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="navLinks" aria-label="Toggle menu">
        <span></span><span></span><span></span>
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="progress" id="progressBar" aria-hidden="true"></div>
</header>

<main id="main">

  <!-- ================= HERO ================= -->
  <section class="hero" id="top">
    <canvas class="hero-canvas" id="plankton" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
    <div class="hero-content">
      <p class="hero-kicker">A Field Guide to the Living Sea</p>
      <h1>The ocean is <em>alive</em> — and it is running out of time.</h1>
      <p class="hero-sub">It holds 97% of the planet's water, makes roughly half the air you breathe, and absorbs most of our excess heat. Eighty percent of it has never been mapped. This is the last great wilderness on Earth.</p>
      <div class="hero-cta">
        <a class="btn btn-primary" href="#depth">Begin the descent
          <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 4v16m0 0 6-6m-6 6-6-6"/></svg>
        </a>
        <a class="btn btn-ghost" href="#act">How you can act</a>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="hero-waves" aria-hidden="true">
      <svg class="wave wave-1" viewBox="0 0 5760 140" preserveAspectRatio="none"><path d="M0 70 Q180 24 360 70 T720 70 T1080 70 T1440 70 T1800 70 T2160 70 T2520 70 T2880 70 T3240 70 T3600 70 T3960 70 T4320 70 T4680 70 T5040 70 T5400 70 T5760 70 L5760 140 L0 140 Z"/></svg>
      <svg class="wave wave-2" viewBox="0 0 5760 140" preserveAspectRatio="none"><path d="M0 74 Q180 30 360 74 T720 74 T1080 74 T1440 74 T1800 74 T2160 74 T2520 74 T2880 74 T3240 74 T3600 74 T3960 74 T4320 74 T4680 74 T5040 74 T5400 74 T5760 74 L5760 140 L0 140 Z"/></svg>
      <svg class="wave wave-3" viewBox="0 0 5760 140" preserveAspectRatio="none"><path d="M0 78 Q180 40 360 78 T720 78 T1080 78 T1440 78 T1800 78 T2160 78 T2520 78 T2880 78 T3240 78 T3600 78 T3960 78 T4320 78 T4680 78 T5040 78 T5400 78 T5760 78 L5760 140 L0 140 Z"/></svg>
    </div>

  <section class="section section--alt" aria-labelledby="whyTitle">
    <div class="container why-grid">
      <div class="why-copy reveal">
        <p class="overline">Vital Signs</p>
        <h2 class="section-title" id="whyTitle">Half of every breath you take is the ocean's.</h2>
        <p>Long before the first forest, tiny drifting plants called phytoplankton began photosynthesising at sea. Together with other marine life, they still produce roughly half of the oxygen in the atmosphere — more than all of the Amazon rainforest combined.</p>
        <p>The ocean is also Earth's great thermostat. It has absorbed more than 90% of the extra heat trapped by greenhouse gases, along with about a quarter of the carbon dioxide we have emitted. That buffering is why the planet has not warmed faster — and it is why the sea is warming, acidifying, and losing oxygen at the same time.</p>
        <p>Every coastline, weather system, drinking-water supply, and food supply on land is downstream of what happens in the water. Caring for the ocean is not a niche environmental issue. It is the baseline condition of life on Earth.</p>
      </div>

      <aside class="fact-card reveal" style="--d:.15s" aria-label="Key facts">
        <h3>Numbers worth holding</h3>
        <p>Small figures, enormous consequences.</p>
        <div class="fact-row">
          <span class="fact-ico" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 3s6 6.4 6 10.2A6 6 0 0 1 6 13.2C6 9.4 12 3 12 3Z"/></svg></span>
          <div><b>Every 2 minutes</b><small>a cargo ship's worth of plastic enters the sea</small></div>
        </div>
        <div class="fact-row">
          <span class="fact-ico" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M4 15c2-2.5 4-2.5 6 0s4 2.5 6 0 4-2.5 6 0M4 9c2-2.5 4-2.5 6 0s4 2.5 6 0 4-2.5 6 0"/></svg></span>
          <div><b>3 billion tonnes</b><small>of CO₂ the ocean absorbs every year</small></div>
        </div>
        <div class="fact-row">
          <span class="fact-ico" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M3 12h18M12 3c3 3.5 3 14.5 0 18M12 3c-3 3.5-3 14.5 0 18"/></svg></span>
          <div><b>≈ 3.5 billion people</b><small>depend on the ocean for a primary source of protein</small></div>
        </div>
        <div class="fact-row">
          <span class="fact-ico" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 21s-7-4.6-7-10a7 7 0 0 1 14 0c0 5.4-7 10-7 10Z"/><circle cx="12" cy="11" r="2.5"/></svg></span>
          <div><b>11,000 metres</b><small>down to Challenger Deep — deeper than Everest is tall</small></div>
        </div>
      </aside>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ================= DEPTH ================= -->
  <section class="section" id="depth" aria-labelledby="depthTitle">
    <div class="container">
      <p class="overline reveal">The Descent</p>
      <h2 class="section-title reveal" id="depthTitle">Five worlds, stacked from sunlight to midnight.</h2>
      <p class="section-lede reveal">As you sink, light fails first, then warmth, then almost everything we recognise as "surface life." Select a zone to take a submersible there — the pressure gauge is not exaggerating.</p>

      <div class="depth-layout">
        <div class="zone-list reveal" role="tablist" aria-label="Ocean depth zones">
          <button class="zone-btn active" data-zone="0" role="tab" aria-selected="true">
            <span class="zone-no">I</span>
            <span><span class="zone-name">Sunlight Zone</span><br><span class="zone-lat">Epipelagic · warm, bright, crowded</span></span>
            <span class="zone-range">0–200 m</span>
          </button>
          <button class="zone-btn" data-zone="1" role="tab" aria-selected="false">
            <span class="zone-no">II</span>
            <span><span class="zone-name">Twilight Zone</span><br><span class="zone-lat">Mesopelagic · the last blue glow</span></span>
            <span class="zone-range">200–1,000 m</span>
          </button>
          <button class="zone-btn" data-zone="2" role="tab" aria-selected="false">
            <span class="zone-no">III</span>
            <span><span class="zone-name">Midnight Zone</span><br><span class="zone-lat">Bathypelagic · bioluminescent darkness</span></span>

          </button>
          <button class="zone-btn" data-zone="3" role="tab" aria-selected="false">
            <span class="zone-no">IV</span>

          <button class="zone-btn" data-zone="4" role="tab" aria-selected="false">

        </div>

        <div class="descent reveal" style="--d:.15s" aria-live="polite">

            <h3 id="roName">Sunlight Zone</h3>
            <p class="zone-desc" id="roDesc">Sunlit, warm and crowded: nearly all coral reefs and the bulk of marine life live here, built on phytoplankton that turn light into the base of the food web.</p>
            <div class="readout-grid">
              <div class="readout-cell"><small>Depth</small><strong id="roDepth">0–200 m</strong></div>

  </section>

  <!-- ================= LIFE ================= -->
  <section class="section section--alt" id="life" aria-labelledby="lifeTitle">
    <div class="container">
      <p class="overline reveal">Life</p>
      <h2 class="section-title reveal" id="lifeTitle">Residents of the water column.</h2>
      <p class="section-lede reveal">From the largest animal that has ever existed to a fish filmed at a depth where the pressure could crush a submarine hull — the sea keeps inventing life we barely know.</p>

      <div class="species-grid">
        <article class="species reveal">
          <div class="species-top">
            <span class="species-ico" aria-hidden="true">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" fill="currentColor">
                <path d="M6 36c4-13 22-20 37-15 8 2.6 13 8 13 12-2.5 2.6-6.5 3.6-10.5 3.2 1.8 3.6.9 7.6-2.4 10.6-1.8-2.7-5-3.7-8-3l-.6-3.2C25 45 12 43.5 6 36Z"/>
                <circle cx="45" cy="30.5" r="2" fill="var(--bg)"/>
                <path d="M18 20c-1.5-4-1.5-7 .5-10M24 22c-1-3.4-.6-6.6 1.4-9.4" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
              </svg>
            </span>
            <span class="species-range">0 – 100 m</span>
          </div>
          <h3>Blue Whale</h3>
          <p>The largest animal to have ever lived — up to 30 metres long, with a heart the size of a small car and a voice you can hear from kilometres away.</p>
        </article>

        <article class="species reveal" style="--d:.08s">
          <div class="species-top">
            <span class="species-ico" aria-hidden="true">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" fill="currentColor">
                <path d="M32 12c3.4 0 6.6.5 9.4 1.6C47 17 53 24 57 34c-7.6-4.2-15.6-6.4-25-6.4S14.6 30 7 34c4-10 10-17 15.6-20.4C25.4 12.5 28.6 12 32 12Z"/>
                <path d="M30 20c2 4 2 8 0 12M34 20c-2 4-2 8 0 12" stroke="var(--bg)" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none" opacity=".5"/>
                <path d="M32 34v18c0 2-1.4 3-3 4 1-3 .4-5.6-1-8" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
              </svg>
            </span>
            <span class="species-range">0 – 50 m</span>
          </div>
          <h3>Manta Ray</h3>
          <p>The largest brain of any fish — about four times the relative size of a human's. Mantas are known to visit cleaning stations by name, almost like a place.</p>
        </article>

        <article class="species reveal" style="--d:.16s">
          <div class="species-top">
            <span class="species-ico" aria-hidden="true">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" fill="currentColor">
                <path d="M14 32c6-8 16-12 26-9l12 9-12 9c-10 3-20-1-26-9Z"/>
                <path d="M34 22c3-4 8-6 13-5-2 4-5 6-9 7ZM36 42c3 4 8 6 13 5-2-4-5-6-9-7Z" opacity=".8"/>
                <circle cx="21" cy="30" r="1.8" fill="var(--bg)"/>
                <circle class="glowdot" cx="26" cy="38" r="2.4"/>
              </svg>
            </span>
            <span class="species-range">30 – 700 m</span>
          </div>
          <h3>Lanternfish</h3>
          <p>Possibly the most abundant vertebrate on Earth. Every night, billions rise through the twilight zone in the largest migration of animals anywhere on the planet.</p>
        </article>

        <article class="species reveal" style="--d:.24s">
          <div class="species-top">
            <span class="species-ico" aria-hidden="true">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" fill="currentColor">
                <path d="M32 12c10 0 17 7 17 15 0 4-2 7-5 9H20c-3-2-5-5-5-9 0-8 7-15 17-15Z"/>
                <path d="M21 38c-1 6 1 12 4 16M28 38c0 7-1 13-3 18M36 38c0 7 1 13 3 18M43 38c1 6-1 12-4 16" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
                <circle cx="26" cy="26" r="2" fill="var(--bg)"/><circle cx="38" cy="26" r="2" fill="var(--bg)"/>
              </svg>
            </span>
            <span class="species-range">600 – 900 m</span>
          </div>
          <h3>Vampire Squid</h3>
          <p>Neither vampire nor squid — a living fossil that glows with hundreds of photophores when threatened and can switch off its metabolism to survive oxygen-poor water.</p>
        </article>

        <article class="species reveal" style="--d:.32s">
          <div class="species-top">
            <span class="species-ico" aria-hidden="true">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" fill="currentColor">
                <path d="M10 36c3-9 14-14 25-11 4 1 7 3 9 6l8-3c-2 3-3 6-3 9s1 6 3 9l-8-3c-2 3-5 5-9 6-11 3-22-2-25-13Z"/>

                <circle cx="18" cy="34" r="2" fill="var(--bg)"/>

            </span>
            <span class="species-range">900 – 4,500 m</span>
          </div>
          <h3>Anglerfish</h3>
          <p>In the lightless midnight zone, she grows a glowing lure from her own spine and dangles it in the dark — the sea's oldest trick, perfected over 300 million years.</p>
        </article>

        <article class="species reveal" style="--d:.4s">
          <div class="species-top">
            <span class="species-ico" aria-hidden="true">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round">
